_comment: AC-CUT-5: planning-authority phrasings that foundry_migrate.py preview reports in CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md / WORKFLOW.md / CONSTITUTION.md, each with a proposed replacement sentence. Entries are scoped to PLANNING authority only; the front-authorization floor, the merge floor, security review and sign-off are never targeted (a matched sentence that names one is also dropped by the tool). `match` is a case-insensitive regex tried against one sentence; first matching entry wins. The operator applies any change through a reviewed diff; the tool never writes these files.

entries.match: \brelease (manifest|\.yaml)s?\b.{0,80}\b(work context|acceptance record|planning authority|planning record|source of truth)
entries.after: For work moved to GitHub, the issue is the work context and the acceptance record; a release manifest is retained history for items that have not been migrated.
Shape and plan work as a GitHub issue; /foundry:release remains available for the factory lane.
Routine work starts from a Ready GitHub issue; a written spec is required for the factory lane (for example security-flagged work), not as a routine prerequisite.
